attributes.description:
The elevator is closed for major equipment upgrades that will significantly improve the long-term reliability of this elevator.

To board a Red Line Train: Proceed to the Orange Line Oak Grove Platform at the opposite end of the concourse. Take elevator 998 or 999 to the Red Line passage, then follow signs to Alewife. 
  
To exit the station: Proceed to the north end of the platform to the Orange - Red Line passage. Take Elevator 998 or 999 to the Orange Line Oak Grove platform. Exit the station using the 101 Arch St Elevator on the Summer St concourse.
attributes.header: Downtown Crossing Elevator 869 (Alewife platform to Summer Street Concourse) is unavailable due to maintenance through Tuesday, December 1.

attributes.description:
The elevator is closed for major equipment upgrades that will significantly improve the long-term reliability of this elevator.

To board a Train to Forest Hills: Cross Milk St and go south on Washington St for one-tenth of a mile (two blocks) to the intersection of Washington St and Winter St. Take Downtown Crossing Elevator 892 to the Forest Hills platform. 
 
To board a Train to Oak Grove: Cross Milk St and go south on Washington St for 500 ft (one block) to the intersection of Washington St and Franklin St. Take Downtown Crossing Elevator 891 to the Oak Grove platform. 
 
To exit the station: Go to the end of the Forest Hills platform and continue down the hallway (follow signs for Oak Grove and Blue Line) to the Wonderland platform. At the Wonderland platform, go to the 53 State St lobby and use State Elevator 975 to exit.
attributes.header: State Elevator 803 (Forest Hills platform to Washington Street, Milk Street) is unavailable due to maintenance through Tuesday, December 1.

attributes.description: To access Ocean Blvd from the pedestrian plaza, travel along the plaza towards the station and use Wonderland Elevator 710 to access the Wonderland outbound platform. At the platform, exit through the gate and continue along the pathway to Ocean Blvd. To access the pedestrian plaza from Ocean Blvd, travel south on Ocean Blvd for approximately 300 feet, then turn right at the Wonderland pathway. Proceed to the Wonderland platform and use Wonderland Elevator 710.

attributes.description:
Scope of Work:
This is to allow for work on critical signal upgrades within the Green Line central subway.

Travel Time:
Riders should allow for ample extra travel time. Rider trip times are expected to be at least 25 minutes longer than usual. 

Accessibility:
All shuttle buses are accessible to riders with disabilities. Accessible van service will be available for Green Line stops between Kenmore & North Station as well as Downtown Crossing. See station personnel for assistance.

Commuter Rail Alternates:
Framingham/Worcester Line is free between Lansdowne and South Station

Bus Alternatives:
Route 39 Bus will be fare-free. This route runs parallel to the Green Line E Branch 

Route 57 Bus will be fare-free. This route runs parallel to the Green Line B Branch between Kenmore and Packard's Corner.
